name: Alchemy FM Channel Designer
author: MMagTech
description: Design live radio channels in AudioMuse using CLAP, lyrics, mood clusters, and Song Alchemy — preview programming, then deploy to Alchemy FM.

versions.changelog: Add a Station Artwork picker to Step 1 so you can attach art before a station ever exists, not just afterward from the edit toolbar. Alchemy FM's artwork endpoint requires a station id, which doesn't exist until the first successful deploy, so the staged file uploads automatically the moment Deploy creates or updates the station; a failed upload is a warning, not a blocker on the rest of the deploy. Main designer form now uses multipart/form-data.

Clean up the 'Editing Station' toolbar layout: split the single crowded row of eleven controls and a raw file input into three groups (identity + navigation/save at top, a labeled 'Station Operations' row, a labeled 'Station Artwork' row). Restyled the artwork file picker as a proper button with a live-updating chosen-filename label instead of the unstyled native file input that was truncating its own text.
